name: 1-play.jpg
shows: Wave 7 of 10 on the brighter indigo arena, the best of twenty autopilot runs and kept calm: an Azure main beam (lit in the colour bar) with Prism branches reflecting off mirror shards and striking Shades of different colours, a Shade dying to its own colour in a bright ring burst, only two score popups, 14 Shades on the field with none under a panel, the Core clear, combo x6. The HUD states the rules in words: 'WIN: break THE ECLIPSE after wave 10 · LOSE: the Core shatters', CORE with '0 = RUN LOST', 'HOLD 3 MORE WAVES · THEN THE ECLIPSE', INCOMING with counts, an event log, 'MATCH THE BEAM TO THE SHADE' and the named build.

name: 2-title.jpg
shows: The title screen: logo, tagline, 'OBJECTIVE  WIN: break THE ECLIPSE after wave 10 · LOSE: the Core shatters', '10 waves · 6 kinds of Shade · 9 upgrades · a three-phase boss', a live reflected beam show, controls, RULES OF LIGHT opening with 'Match the beam to the Shade's colour', BEST SCORE 28,410 and 'Click to begin'.

name: 3-upgrade.jpg
shows: The moment before the boss: WAVE 9 CLEARED with a large 'NEXT: THE ECLIPSE' preview drawn by the boss's own renderer and its three phases (UMBRA, PENUMBRA, TOTALITY) named one per line, above three upgrade cards with icon, level, effect and how each combines with the build, plus Core, score and YOUR BUILD.

name: 4-results.jpg
shows: VICTORY with THE ECLIPSE drawn small beneath it, dimmed and cracked, then the stats (waves, Shades dispelled, colour accuracy, best combo, time), score 32,925 marked NEW BEST over the previous 28,410, the build taken by name and level, and 'Press R or click to play again'. Below it: 'Lose the Core and the run ends: CORE SHATTERED · press R to try again' (the real defeat screen is ?shot=defeat).
